name: First Cabin International Seoul Myeongdong
detail: I visited a place that opened in August 2026, and it was very clean with staff who spoke Japanese well and provided polite service, making it a安心 (safe) experience. The amenities included makeup remover, facial soap, and a hairdryer in the communal shower room, and with pajamas, towels, and slippers provided, I only needed to bring my toothbrush, making it very convenient. Although it is located in the bustling area of Myeongdong, being on the 7th floor, it had good soundproofing and a quiet environment. It was also helpful that they were able to hold my large luggage easily after checkout. I would like to use this service again.

name: Solo Stay Myeongdong
detail: Check-in can basically be done through messaging, so it was smooth to use. The clientele was calm, with no one being noisy, allowing for a comfortable stay. Above all, the location is excellent! It’s within a 5-minute walk to subway lines 1 and 2, and within 10 minutes to line 4, making it convenient for travel. Just outside the room, there's a Seven-Eleven and a convenience store called 25, and Starbucks is just a 1-minute walk away. Lotte Department Store is right in front as well. I think having this location at this price is quite rare. Not only is it affordable, but it's also close to the station, well-equipped, and includes free breakfast, which is highly rated. The only drawback is that since it’s a capsule hotel, the air in the room can feel stagnant. For those concerned, it might be good to bring a small USB-powered fan. The room also had USB Type-C outlets and a mirror, which was convenient. Considering the location, cleanliness, and price overall, it's a hotel I would definitely like to use again!

name: MOOGM Euljiro
detail: The bus stop and subway are very close, safe even in the early morning or at night, allowing you to go anywhere. With excellent access, I would quickly return to drop off my shopping when my bags got heavy. There is also a convenience store nearby. (From Gimpo Airport, you can get there directly by subway without any transfers. There is a limousine bus stop next to the subway station for Incheon Airport.) There are many markets and restaurants within walking distance, and the river flowing in front of the hotel has clean water, making it pleasant to walk to Dongdaemun. The room and facilities were simple, clean, stylish, and comfortable. There is a powerful hairdryer, a curling iron, and amenities like shampoo, body soap, toothbrushes, and earplugs are provided. (I found it convenient to bring disposable slippers for indoor use, the shower room, and the toilet.) The check-in and check-out system was easy and quick, saving time. I stayed alone for three nights, and it was sufficient just for sleeping. I would like to use this hotel again when I come to Korea alone.

name: Hotel Peyto Samseong
detail: The COEX Mall and Hyundai Department Store are right in front, providing a well-equipped shopping environment. It is conveniently located near subway lines 2 and 9, as well as bus services. There is a convenience store on the first floor, a McDonald's next door, and many restaurants nearby. The airport limousine bus stop is also right in front. The room is simple but has a bathtub, and they provide bottled water. The cleaning staff are friendly as well, making it a place I would like to revisit.

name: PATIO7 Hotel
detail: It is a bit far from both the center of Seoul and Incheon Airport, but it is reasonably priced. The nearest station is also within a 5-minute walk. Taxis in Korea are cheap (around 2000 yen for a ride of about 45 minutes), so using a taxi is convenient. The exchange rate at the currency exchange machine was the best among the three places I visited! There was no bathtub, but the toilet and shower room were clean. The only downside was that the water pressure was low. I think it might take longer for those with long hair to shower, haha. There is also ice available, but it didn't upset my stomach! There is a convenience store (7-Eleven) right nearby, which was convenient. At night, there was a bit of noise from cars, but there were earplugs provided.

name: Itaewon A One Hotel
detail: Great stay overall! The hotel is super close to Itaewon Station, so getting around Seoul was really easy. The staff were very friendly and made check-in smooth and simple. The best part is definitely the location—it’s right by Itaewon’s bars and clubs, which made it perfect for a night out and enjoying the nightlife. Despite being in such a lively area, the price was much cheaper than other hotels nearby, so it felt like a really good deal. The room was clean and had everything I needed. If you’re looking for a convenient and affordable spot in Itaewon where you can enjoy the party scene, this place is a solid choice!

name: Klaven Hotel Myeongdong City Hall, Formerly Travelodge Myeongdong City Hall
detail: It is located about a 5-minute walk from Exit 7 of City Hall Station on Line 1, and the location was excellent. The room was spacious and clean, but the TV had difficulty turning on, and the toilet's washlet was broken and unusable, which was a downside. However, there was a coin laundry in the basement (only one machine, though), and the bathroom was very nice with a spacious bathtub, so it was great overall. I would like to stay again if I have the chance next time. The price was very affordable, exceeding *** yen due to an Agoda sale, even during Silver Week, which contributes to my high rating.

name: Bluedot Poshtel Myeongdong
detail: There were curtains on the bed, which was nice for ensuring a bit of privacy. The lockers can have their numbers changed by anyone, so I locked my valuables in my suitcase. There were no bed bugs. The large public bath was a joy for Japanese people, and it was usually not crowded, making it easy to use. Although it could only be used from 16:00 to 22:00 and the bath was a bit too hot, it was understandable considering the accommodation fee was low, and it was relatively clean. There were separate changing rooms for the women's and men's baths, which made changing easy. There were also several toilets separate from the showers! I had brought a bento box for my business trip stay in Seoul, but I was told they couldn't hold refrigerated items before check-in, which was a hassle. There were conveniences such as a freezer, refrigerator, microwave, water purifier, hot water, and dish soap. Be careful as they will only hold your luggage until 17:00 after check-out. The location was right in the heart of Myeongdong, making it convenient to access both Euljiro 1(il)ga Station and Myeongdong Station. I highly recommend it for those who aren't bothered by dormitory-style accommodations. It was clean, reasonably priced, and overall a great experience. You will need: toothbrush, toothpaste, loungewear, sandals/slippers, shampoo, conditioner, a charger with a plug type, and wet wipes.

name: Dormy Inn EXPRESS SEOUL Insadong
detail: I hoped for a hotel with a large public bath for two elderly family members and quickly decided on Dormy Inn Insa-dong. The large bath was available in the early part of the 8 PM hour, and the changing room was clean and comfortable to use. The triple room had independent beds and, although it was small, we were able to spend comfortable time there. Since I had previously stayed at a Dormy Inn in Kyoto, I was thrilled to find that the late-night soba was offered just like in Japan, and it even came with delicious kimchi. I stayed for three nights with breakfast, and besides kimbap, there were Japanese side dishes like natto, as well as bread and sandwiches, which kept us from getting bored each time. The on-site staff in the restaurant kitchen were very friendly and delightful. Additionally, all services were well-equipped, including ice after the bath, a welcome drink, a waopass machine, and hair straightener rentals. There were plenty of shops around, making it easy to buy souvenirs. It was convenient to go up the escalator at exit 4 of Jongno 3-ga Station on Line 5 from Gimpo Airport. I mostly traveled by bus for sightseeing, but I think it was a highly convenient area for transport access. Since my daughter loves saunas, I would like to make this my regular accommodation and visit again! Thank you very much.

name: Hotel Crescendo Seoul
detail: During the holiday, all the nearby hotels had somewhat high prices, but I stayed for 2 nights at a reasonable price through Agoda. It was conveniently located near the subway, which made access easy. The breakfast, which included bread, jam, butter, coffee, orange, cereal, and juice, was simple but nice to eat. Considering the price, it was quite good to have breakfast included. It wasn't luxurious, but it was decent, and the coffee was the best. Especially, all the staff were friendly, and the room was clean. However, the lighting in the room I stayed in was too dim, which was uncomfortable. It felt just right if you were only there to sleep. I found it disappointing that there was no small chair or stand or a bright light that could be switched on for a short time, and there was no wardrobe, resulting in insufficient space to hang or place my things. I commend the cost-effectiveness and cleanliness of the accommodation.
